react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — appears repeatedly in console. Some component (likely in older shared UI) still passes pointerEvents as prop instead of via style. Reference: shows during initial load; grep the codebase for `pointerEvents=` on JSX (not inside style objects). Not a runtime bug but should be migrated for RN 0.75+ / RN Web 0.20+ compatibility.

action_items: OPTIONAL / minor: audit codebase for JSX `pointerEvents=` prop usage and migrate to `style={{pointerEvents:...}}` (RN Web deprecation warning noted in console). Non-blocking.

OPTIONAL: server.py is now 2387 lines (was 2129 last iteration) — /border, /family/wallpaper, /mental, /legal/testament/biometric added inline. Recommend extracting these + previous legacy modules (/legal, /meds, /aml, /solidarity, /dignity) into separate route modules before Publish. Not blocking.

OPTIONAL: /api/mental/techniques currently only exposes SK content regardless of `language` query param. If i18n is expected for mental fortress, add EN/CS/UK translations. Documented as future enhancement (not part of current spec).
critical_code_review_comments: Border certificate PDF + wallpaper PNG + biometric file endpoints correctly implement dual-auth (Authorization header OR ?token= query param via _auth_pdf helper) so tags and browser downloads can authenticate without setting headers. Verified via wp-preview live-render + PDF fetch.

Biometric upload MIME check `ctype.startswith('audio/') or ctype.startswith('video/')` correctly blocks text/plain (test asserts 400 with 'audio' in body). SHA-256 hash + AML ledger append happens BEFORE upsert into biometric_wills so partial-failure recovery is clean.

DELETE /api/legal/testament/biometric returns 404 on missing record and $unsets biometric_hash/biometric_ledger_hash from legal_testaments — good hygiene. Note: storage object is NOT deleted from S3/minio path — file remains at APP_NAME/biometric/<uid>/<rec_id>.<ext>. Consider adding storage deletion for GDPR right-to-be-forgotten.

Mental Fortress: MENTAL_TECHNIQUES_SK is a hardcoded constant with 6 items each having ≥5 SK steps + tts_text is constructed server-side by joining title + 'Krok N: ...'. Fully deterministic, no LLM dependency — good for MVP.

Border certificate: DID signature is `sha256(did + json.dumps(core, sort_keys=True))` — deterministic but includes issued_at timestamp inside `core`, so signature changes each request. This is fine for tamper-evident notarization at query time but means the same doc cannot be re-verified later without archiving the exact `core` payload. Consider persisting core+signature to a certificates_issued collection for future re-verification.
Wallpaper PNG generation is synchronous PIL work wrapped in run_in_threadpool — good. 1080x1920 render is ~8-15KB compressed; verified >5KB in test.

Angel Mode tab bar hiding: (tabs)/_layout.tsx correctly hides the Tab.Screen bar when angel_mode=true (visually confirmed in screenshot — only red SOS + phone + medkit visible, no bottom tabs). DOM anchors persist with display:none which is expected Expo Router behavior; testID count query returns 1 but element is not visually rendered.

Two test-scaffolding notes: (1) First frontend script attempts failed with 'f-string expression part cannot include a backslash' when using page.locator(f'[data-testid="{tid}"]') inside f-strings — Python 3.11 disallows backslashes in f-string interpolation. Workaround: build the selector via string concatenation with repr(tid). (2) Attempting to tap tab-legacy from a non-tab route (/scam-shield) failed because the tab bar is only present inside (tabs) group — navigate to any /(tabs)/* route first or use page.goto('/legacy') directly.
